# Patient RX System v3.0.1

## Patient Service-Date Save Locking

This patch release fixes duplicate service-date history rows when the normal Patient edit workflow receives the same service-date update more than once at nearly the same time.

## What Changed

- Normal Patient updates now use a row-level database lock while saving patient fields, service-date cycles, service-date history, and active/inactive RX cascades.
- Duplicate or concurrent saves for the same Patient service-date change now record one Patient Service Date History entry instead of two.
- Added `npm run test:patient-double-update` to cover the concurrent save scenario.
- Included the Call Center Backoffice service-date-history delete repair follow-up from staging, including queue reopen handling and service-date cycle status repair.

## Database Impact

- No schema migration is required.
- No data reset is included.
- Existing patient records, RX records, audit logs, service-date histories, service-date cycles, roles, permissions, and settings are preserved.

## Verification Checklist

1. Run `npm run test:patient-double-update`.
2. Run `npm run test:call-center-queue-reopen`.
3. Run `npm run test:rx-override`.
4. Run `npm run db:test`.
5. Edit a normal Patient service date once and confirm only one Patient Service Date History row appears for that change.
